name: runtime-versions
title: The runtime versions, as declared and as enforced
description: The release manifest declares python >=3.10 and node >=22.19.0, the workflows pin node 22.19.0 and python 3.11, the bootstrap checks prerequisites, and the READMEs tell a user what to install. A minimum stated in one place and enforced at another can disagree, and the user finds out by being refused after being told they were fine
creator: aixi
